name: Godherja: The Dying World
summary: Godherja: The Dying World is a total fantasy conversion mod that is set in an original dark fantasy world poised on the edge of the end times. After killing their Creator in a time long-forgotten, humanity has once again shaken the fabrics of reality through the use of world-shattering magics. Now, an endless Fog spews forth across the land swallowing all. Strange monsters and men turned wild now roam these lands, and the peoples who once called it home flee for the Shattered Coast. The world is dying. As the tribes migrate to the last safe lands and ancient empires crumble, reality itself hangs in the balance. Will you save the world, or end it?
